name: kmay89-devtools
description: Dev-only tooling for kmay89.com, plus the one dependency of the serverless room mailbox (netlify/functions/) — never a runtime dependency of any game, which all stay dependency-free static pages. See tools/room-check.js.

scripts.check: npm run check:parity && npm run check:room && npm run check:chess
scripts.check:chess: node chess/tools/perft.js && node chess/tools/book-check.js && node chess/tools/teach-check.js && node chess/tools/lesson-check.js && node chess/tools/skin-check.js && node chess/tools/pieces-check.js && node chess/tools/engine-check.js && node chess/tools/offline-check.js
